rv.q: Mitchell's performance is the production's greatest strength.
Besides its quirky approach, Goblin is brutally sad and disturbed.
This wonderfully original production is both enormously entertaining and genuinely affecting.
Hilarious and heartbreakingly human, Goblin is a reminder to never judge your bitchy gay spin instructor.

cn.t: Goblin earns strong notices for Derek Mitchell's charismatic one-man performance, blending sharp comedy with gut-punch emotion in this coming-of-age grooming story. Most critics are won over; a lone dissenter finds the execution uneven.
